hero.filename: Seattle - Pioneer Square totem pole detail 04.jpg
hero.title: File:Seattle - Pioneer Square totem pole detail 04.jpg
hero.source: Seattle - Pioneer Square totem pole detail 04
hero.description:
Detail of totem pole, Pioneer Square, Seattle, Washington, USA. Listed, along with the Pioneer Building and Iron Pergola, on the National Register of Historic Places, ID #77001340. There is also a broader inclusion for the Pioneer Square - Skid Row Historical District.

This is a 1930s replica of the original Pioneer Square totem pole, which was damaged by arson. It is carved by descendants of the original carvers. [1]
categories: National Register of Historic Places with known IDs
